# fw sessions

> Reference of the fw sessions command: List, inspect, or delete saved agent sessions. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/sessions/

List, inspect, or delete saved agent sessions

## Usage

```bash
fw sessions | session <show|delete> <id>
```

## Aliases

`fw session` runs `fw sessions`.

## Subcommands

```bash
fw sessions show
fw sessions delete
```

The names come from the usage line.

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
